figures.title: Stage graph
figures.subtitle: Blue: autoregressive stage on vLLM. Sand: diffusion stage. Pills: what one stage hands the next.

tip.title: Thinker: the multimodal LLM
tip.line: Reads text, audio, image and video; emits text tokens and the hidden states the Talker needs.

tip.title: mm_encode
tip.line: Runs the vision and audio encoders once per request and splices their embeddings into the prompt.

tip.title: thinker_forward
tip.line: Ordinary vLLM decoding, batched across requests, with the last hidden layer kept for the next stage.

tip.title: Thinker2Talker
tip.line: Edge function: hands the Thinker’s hidden states and tokens to the Talker through the connector.

tip.title: Talker: a smaller AR model
tip.line: Turns the Thinker’s hidden states into discrete speech codec tokens.

tip.title: process_input
tip.line: Concatenates the received hidden states with the Talker’s own embeddings before its first step.

tip.title: talker_forward
tip.line: Batched AR decoding of codec tokens, emitted in chunks so the Vocoder can start early.

tip.title: Talker2Vocoder
tip.line: Edge function: streams codec-token chunks to the Vocoder as they are produced.

tip.title: Vocoder: a diffusion transformer
tip.line: Not autoregressive, so it runs on a diffusion engine instead of vLLM.

tip.title: dit_decode
tip.line: Denoises each chunk of codec tokens into audio samples.

figures.title: Engines, connector and devices
figures.subtitle: Control plane on top, data plane below, one engine per stage.

items.label: Orchestrator
items.note: control plane: request queues, stage manager, request metadata

tip.title: Orchestrator
tip.line: Admits requests, tracks each one’s progress through the stage graph and tells engines what to run. Moves no tensors.

tip.title: Thinker engine
tip.line: Owns the Thinker’s scheduler and paged KV cache; its weights are split over two GPUs.

tip.title: Scheduler, KV cache
tip.line: Continuous batching and paged KV memory, per stage.

tip.title: Runner: preprocess, forward
tip.line: Runs the stage’s preprocess hook, then the batched forward.

tip.title: Output processor
tip.line: Detokenizes text and hands hidden states to the edge function.

tip.title: Talker engine
tip.line: A second vLLM engine with its own batch and KV cache, so Talker steps never wait on Thinker steps.

tip.title: Scheduler, KV cache
tip.line: Continuous batching and paged KV memory, per stage.

tip.title: Runner: preprocess, forward
tip.line: Runs the stage’s preprocess hook, then the batched forward.

tip.title: Streaming output
tip.line: Releases codec chunks as soon as they are decoded.

tip.title: Vocoder engine
tip.line: Diffusion-specific speedups: step caching and sequence parallelism across GPUs.

tip.title: Flash / SAGE attention
tip.line: Fused attention kernels for the DiT.

tip.title: TeaCache, cache-DiT
tip.line: Reuses work across denoising steps when outputs barely change.

tip.title: Ulysses / ring SP
tip.line: Splits one long sequence across GPUs.

items.label: Unified connector
items.note: data plane, set per edge: shared memory on one node, Ray + Mooncake over TCP or RDMA across nodes

tip.title: Unified connector
tip.line: Every edge function moves its tensors here; each edge picks its transport, so stages can live on different machines.

tip.title: GPU 0
tip.line: Half the Thinker’s weights, plus the whole Vocoder.

tip.title: GPU 1
tip.line: The other half of the Thinker, plus the Talker.
